summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #416, then merge to main and perform a comprehensive documentation update: pruning stale deferred items, updating feature tables, refreshing the README, creating a filesystem specification, and planning the next two development phases.
summary.outcome: PR #416 was merged after fixing try/catch on postMessage/getWorker in encrypt-worker.service.ts and updating a doc comment in client.ts. A docs branch (PR #419) was created with updated DEFERRED.md (thoroughly audited), FEATURES.md, README.md, a new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md, and ROADMAP.md entries for phases 38 and 39.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the error tracking and remote log shipping solution — not Sentry, Datadog, or Loki.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.
FUSE desktop components are intentionally not unit tested; they are covered by the Desktop E2E suite since unit testing would require mocking too much of the host OS.
Vault v1 legacy columns were fully removed when staging was reset; the baseline migration 1700000000000-FullSchema.ts reflects the clean schema.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable retention is still deferred.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are the remaining deprecated web services not yet migrated to the SDK.
@cipherbox/crypto has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency used only in vault-ipns.test.ts to compare key derivation — a test-only circular dep that was supposed to be removed during Phase 19.1.

Phase 38 will retire folder.service.ts, bin.service.ts, and remove the crypto->core devDependency; Phase 39 will add user-configurable vault parameters (versioning defaults, bin retention, soft/hard delete).
Desktop adopts the Rust FUSE SDK, not the JS SDK — JS SDK migration deferred items do not apply to desktop.
pin:secondaryFailed events, per-file IPNS conflict detection, and batch upload pipeline were all implemented in Phase 37.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw, leaking pending entries — fixed with try/catch that cleans up the pending map on error.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — updated to accurately describe behavior.

Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — flagged by both CodeRabbit and Copilot as a concern, but deferred as it requires an SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array.

Imports deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair and initializeVault from @cipherbox/core only to verify domain separation — should be refactored to use hardcoded test vectors or moved to a cross-package integration test directory.

workflow: When asked to audit/prune a list, go through every single item systematically against the codebase — not just the ones the user explicitly calls out. Shallow passes that remove only what is questioned will keep requiring manual correction rounds.
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions; REST endpoint for PR comment replies requires --field (integer) for in_reply_to, not --raw-field.
Integration tests hitting a live API backend will fail in CI without a running backend — distinguish pre-existing failures from regression before blocking on them.
When verifying whether a deferred item is implemented, grep for the actual code artifact (function name, file, env var) rather than relying on phase summaries alone.

friction: Initial deferred item audit was too shallow — only removed the 3 items the user called out rather than systematically verifying every entry, requiring multiple correction rounds.
Edit tool reformatted table whitespace in DEFERRED.md, making subsequent edits require re-reading the file to get exact strings.
The 'Production Kubo deployment hardening' and 'session replay' items should have been caught in the first audit pass as obviously out-of-scope or already-implemented.

The user had to explicitly point out that Grafana Faro = remote log shipping, that FUSE tests are intentionally not unit tested, and that vault v1 columns were already removed — all of which should have been discovered during the audit.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts and bin.service.ts, migrate remaining callers to SDK methods, and remove the @cipherbox/crypto devDependency on @cipherbox/core by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts to use hardcoded test vectors.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — versioning defaults, bin retention period (end-user setting, distinct from operator env var), and soft-delete vs hard-delete preference.
Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts (line 140) — requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array; tracked as architectural deferred item.
PR #419 (docs branch) is open and needs review/merge.
Filesystem specification (docs/FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md) documents 5 cross-platform gaps that may need future resolution.
